bebboget 1.11 by Stefan "Bebbo" Franke: an https/http downloader for the
Amiga that needs only a bsdsocket.library, as published on Aminet:

  https://aminet.net/comm/net/bebboget.lha   ($VER: amigaget 1.11 (05.12.2025))
    bebboget (68020+), bebboget00 (68000), installcerts: the archive's
    binaries, unmodified; bebboget.readme, COPYING, LICENSE: from the archive

  bebboget-1.11-src.tar.bz2: the complete corresponding source, the
  author's repository https://franke.ms/git/bebbo/bebboget at commit
  b18e500 ("Release 1.11").

Licence: GNU General Public License version 3 or later (COPYING, LICENSE).
It has no certificates of its own: installcerts adds them (they go to
ENVARC:certs); see bebboget.readme.
